purpose: Exact small plaintext-feedback constraint test across independently selected alphabet roles; no guessed alphabets or broader cipher exclusion
baseline: data/k4.json; literal97 uppercase letters and24 crib letters at fixed one-based positions22-34 and64-74
roles: Ap plaintext order, Ac ciphertext order, Ak feedback/primer order. Each independently AZ=ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ or KR=KRYPTOSABCDEFGHIJLMNQUVWXZ. Exclude the two triples with all three orders identical. Exactly6 triples remain.
model: Ac.index(C_i)=sigma*Ap.index(P_i)+tau*Ak.index(K_i) mod26. i=0..96. L=9,10,11,12. K_i is independent arbitrary primer character u_i for i<L, else literal plaintext character P_(i-L). Feedback characters are reindexed through Ak. No indicator shifts, CT feedback, reverse direction, transposition, padding, guessed alphabets or word scoring.

exact_method: Each lane r moduloL has arbitrary root Ap.index(P_r). Every transition is a bijection: P_i=Ap[sigma*(Ac.index(C_i)-tau*Ak.index(P_(i-L))) mod26]. Backward transition from a known P_j gives P_(j-L)=Ak[tau*(Ac.index(C_j)-sigma*Ap.index(P_j)) mod26]. Follow backwards to root, even through unknown plaintext. Each known letter pins exactly one root value. A lane with inconsistent requirements rejects a model; otherwise exact compatible primer count26^(L-occupied_lanes). Save all24 implied roots and first conflict plus intervening positions. No brute-force97-letter key or arbitrary completion.
heldout: First fit only13 EASTNORTHEAST letters. These consecutive indices cover every lane forL<=12. If consistent, forward decode using the forced roots and predict BERLINCLOCK without updating keys from Berlin; save checkable count and matches. Both cribs were known before model design, so this is not independent plaintext evidence. A candidate requires all24 known letters, zero free lanes and exact full97 regeneration. Emit complete plaintext only behind this gate, labeled crib_fit_only. Any actual fit requires independent audit before interpretation; never claim a solution.

controls: Positive planted instances for all72 configurations via independent sequential encryption/decryption; verify full roundtrip, exact compatibility, root values and zero free lanes. Change one known plaintext at a repeated lane to require a different root while keeping ciphertext fixed; verify contradiction. Compare exact root-classifier solution counts to exhaustive primer enumeration for tiny moduli with distinct role permutations; compare modal score against exhaustive roots on a toy. Compare same-alphabet synthetic limiting cases with established affine solver. Independently verify saved actual conflict certificates and all hashes after run.
